rawItems.title: Drivers face 24-DAY closure as work continues on £1 billion road upgrade near Hunts
rawItems.content: Drivers face a major road closure near St Neots next week as work continues on the £1 billion A428 Black Cat to Caxton Gibbet scheme. Barford Road in Little Barford will be closed 24 hours a day from 9pm on Friday, September 25, until 6am on Monday, October 19, National Highways said. The closure will allow engineers to install drainage and complete final tie-in work for the new A428 road alignment. Residents inside the closure area will still have access, but the road will remain shut throughout the works, National Highways said. rawItems.title: Warboys home with indoor pool and leisure facilities for sale at over £700,000
rawItems.content: A four-bedroom property in Warboys with an indoor swimming pool is up for sale at offers over £700,000. Regent House is a semi-detached property with outbuildings housing the pool, a gym and other recreational facilities. Selling agent Fine & Country said the “characterful and beautifully presented period home” is set in just under half an acre. Entering the property, the porch opens to the entrance hall, which leads to the main reception rooms and the rear hallway. The sitting room features bespoke cabinetry either side of the chimney breast, which has an oak mantel and wood-burning stove. There's a wood-burning stove in the sitting room (Image: Fine & Country) There's a large inglenook fireplace in the panelled dining room (Image: Fine & Country) In the panelled formal dining room, there’s a large inglenook fireplace. The recently refitted kitchen features a range cooker and bespoke cabinetry (Image: Fine & Country) The rear hallway gives access to the recently refitted kitchen, which features bespoke cabinetry, quartz worksurfaces, integrated appliances including a Bertazzoni range cooker, a Quooker tap and a wine chiller. items.title: Young Carers: Support & Parent Concern Form
items.content: At our school, we are proud to support our Young Carers and recognise the important role they play within their families. We work closely with Centre 33 to provide external support, while internally we offer fortnightly Young Carers sessions where children can come together to chat, share experiences, take part in activities, and relax in a supportive environment. Led by Miss Coles and Mrs Flisher, with support from Mr Bostock, these sessions help ensure our Young Carers feel valued, understood, and supported. We are also committed to raising awareness across the school community and celebrating the dedication, resilience, and compassion shown by our Young Carers every day. Please follow the link below to flag any child that you may deem to be a Young Carer. A Young Carer is a child young person who helps to look after a family member who may have an illness, disability, mental health difficulty, or who may need extra support for another reason. This care can include practical tasks, emotional support, or helping siblings, and it may take place before or after the school day. We recognise that these responsibilities can sometimes impact a child’s wellbeing, learning, and emotional needs. All conversations and responses will be treated sensitively and in confidence. Young Carers Parent Concern form – Fill in form
